summary: CI-only change. The `Test JS` workflow (tests.yml: lint, unit/type tests, release gate, E2E, WASM E2E, Bun) gains a pull_request `paths: ['**', '!docs/plans/**']` filter, so a PR that touches only docs/plans/ no longer runs it; push to main stays unfiltered. To keep that safe, the frozen-publisher-docs test stops reading the EQL plan, a new test asserts no test file names a docs/plans/*.md path, and the workflow-filter guard tests are switched to a shared, order-aware `filterCovers` helper so they understand negations. No shipped package code changes. Mixed PRs still run the full workflow, and main still runs everything after merge, so the residual risks are a plan-only PR merging something a non-test CI step would have rejected (none found reading plans today), required checks left Pending if repository rules require Test JS jobs (the repo's own test-eql.yml comment warns about exactly this but also records that no checks are currently required), and the loss of the plan-vs-FROZEN_PUBLISHERS consistency guard. All are low impact and recoverable. Tests were not run.

behaviour_changes.description: Test JS no longer triggers on pull requests whose changed files are all under docs/plans/. Any PR with at least one other file still triggers it; push to main is unchanged and unfiltered.

frozen-publisher-docs.test.mjs no longer holds docs/plans/2026-08-13-eql-monorepo-absorption.md to FROZEN_PUBLISHERS: the plan's Phase-5 `@cipherstash/eql` instruction is no longer checked against the map (AGENTS.md updated to match).

New invariant test: no file matching **/__tests__/**, **/*.test.* or e2e/** may name a literal docs/plans/<name>.md path. It is a text scan and does not cover non-test CI scripts or paths built at runtime.

Workflow-filter guard tests (auth-binding-step-order, wasm-build-inputs-paths-filter, workflow-trigger-comments) now evaluate `paths:` lists with last-match-wins semantics via scripts/__tests__/lib/paths-filter.mjs instead of `some(entry covers)`; tests.yml's pull_request list is now read as filtered rather than skipped as unfiltered, and the parity test records its push/pull_request asymmetry as expected.

failure_scenarios.title: A plan-only PR merges something a Test JS step would have rejected, turning main red
failure_scenarios.trigger: A PR touching only docs/plans/ when some step run by Test JS (release:gate, a lint:* script, code:check, or a test that builds a plan path at runtime) reads plan content.
failure_scenarios.mechanism: tests.yml no longer runs for that PR (E-1). The new guard (E-5) only scans test files for a literal docs/plans/<name>.md string, so a non-test CI script or a dynamically built path is not covered. I found no current reader: release-gate.mjs only names the plan in a message string (E-8) and lint-no-dead-package-paths excludes plans (E-10).
failure_scenarios.consequence: The break is first seen on the unfiltered push-to-main run (E-2), after merge; fixed by a follow-up or revert. No shipped artefact is affected.

existing_verification.description: plan-docs-unread-by-tests.test.mjs asserts no test file names a plan, with a positive control on release-gate.mjs.
paths-filter.test.mjs pins tests.yml's filter to exactly one negation, '!docs/plans/**'.

missing_verification: The plan-reader scan does not include non-test scripts invoked by tests.yml (scripts/*.mjs run via pnpm run lint:* / release:gate).
failure_scenarios.mitigation: Accept (main still runs everything), or widen the scan's pathspecs to scripts/*.mjs excluding message-only references.

failure_scenarios.title: Required Test JS checks stay Pending on plan-only PRs
failure_scenarios.trigger: A repository ruleset or branch protection requires any Test JS job (e.g. 'Lint (Biome)' or 'Run Tests (Node …)') and a PR changes only docs/plans/.
failure_scenarios.mechanism: A workflow skipped by a path filter reports no check run, so a required check never resolves. The repo itself documents this as the reason test-eql.yml has no pull_request path filter (E-9).
failure_scenarios.consequence: Plan-only PRs cannot merge without an admin override or an unrelated file change. Loud, no data or release impact.
missing_verification: Current required-status-check configuration for main is not available to this assessment.
failure_scenarios.mitigation: Confirm no Test JS job is a required check; if one becomes required, switch to a changes-job + per-job `if:` pattern as test-eql.yml does.

failure_scenarios.title: EQL cutover plan can drift from FROZEN_PUBLISHERS unchecked
failure_scenarios.trigger: @cipherstash/eql leaves FROZEN_PUBLISHERS (Phase-5 cutover) or the plan text is edited.
failure_scenarios.mechanism: The DOCS entry that asserted the plan carries its `@cipherstash/eql` instruction iff the map does was removed (E-3), while release-gate.mjs still directs an operator to that plan's Phase-5 cutover when the gate fails (E-8).
failure_scenarios.consequence: An operator or agent could follow a stale plan instruction during the cutover; detected only by human review.

existing_verification.description: AGENTS.md and SECURITY.md remain held to the map by frozen-publisher-docs.test.mjs.

missing_verification: Nothing checks the plan's Phase-5 wording against the map any more.
failure_scenarios.mitigation: Intentional trade-off; consider moving the operational Phase-5 instruction out of the plan into a held doc, or pointing release-gate's message at SECURITY.md/AGENTS.md.
